title: Sealed Hearing
description: Recover testimony from a hearing whose transcript was never published.
condition: All required objectives must be secured. Optional archives pay extra. Quiet bonus uses peak trace.
aftermath: Every witness received a different explanation for the same missing hour.

lore.title: Sealed Hearing / Unsent message
lore.text: RHEA / public archivist: Recover testimony from a hearing whose transcript was never published. The sender asks you to keep the names attached to the evidence; anonymous totals have concealed people before.

lore.title: Sealed Hearing / Custody note
lore.text: Archive custody, Sealed Hearing: Every witness received a different explanation for the same missing hour. A second copy carries a hand-written objection to the official disposition.

lore.title: Sealed Hearing / Private annotation
lore.text: Personal note filed under sealed-hearing: Every witness received a different explanation for the same missing hour. Someone has crossed out the word inevitable. No replacement was supplied.

revelation: Every witness received a different explanation for the same missing hour.
